notes.s5_pocomc: SKIPPED: pre-approved drop (P2b brief); S4 adaptive tempered SMC covers preconditioned-SMC scientifically.
notes.ess_semantics: bj_smc/nautilus_runner efficiency ESS is importance-weight based (ess_source in each cell); their R-hat is a weak pseudo-chain diagnostic on exchangeable draws and is NOT used to fail them on the R-hat criterion; mode occupancy/logZ carry their weight.
notes.t0_init: T0 cells: contenders use the zoo's analytic InitBundle (free); S0 pays its own MAP+SVI per its published recipe. T0 ESS/grad therefore favors contenders; T1 bills the init cache identically to every consumer.
